verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an LLM tracing and observability service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only tracing, evaluation, cost tracking, OTel ingestion and a generic REST/OpenAPI surface. Nothing in it describes retention policies, TTLs, or deleting traces or other data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
